content_sections.heading: AAI Consultant Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: A total of 10 vacancies have been announced across Law (05), Corporate Communications (03), and Clinical Psychology (02) directorates.

content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Only Indian Nationals are eligible to apply for all posts. Candidates applying for more than one post should submit a separate application for each post. For the Law post, qualification must be from National Law Universities, other Universities established by Acts of Central or State legislature, or institutions declared as Deemed University under Section 3 of the UGC Act, recognised by the Bar Council of India. For Corporate Communications posts, qualifications should be from approved recognized institutions. Skills and Competencies: Content Writer: Ability to craft clear, concise, grammatically accurate, and engaging content in English & Hindi; creative and conceptual thinking; ability to interpret complex data or subjects and convert them into simplified, engaging narratives. Graphic Designer: Proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign, After Effects, Premiere Pro) and Corel Draw; strong sense of typography, colour theory, layout, and visual hierarchy; digital design skills including social media creatives, infographics, GIFs, and banner design. Applicants must submit a comprehensive portfolio. Video Editor: Proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite (Premiere Pro, After Effects, Photoshop, Audition, Media Encoder); knowledge of DaVinci Resolve/Final Cut Pro/Avid Media Composer; understanding of video composition, pacing, transitions, colour grading, audio mixing, and motion graphics.

rows.qualification: Professional degree in Law (3 years regular course after graduation OR 5 years integrated regular course after 10+2); candidate should be eligible to get himself enrolled as an Advocate in the Bar Council of India to practice in courts in India.
Bachelor's degree in Mass Communication, Journalism, or English Literature from a recognised university, OR Bachelor's degree in any stream with a Master's Degree in Mass Communication/Journalism.
rows.required_experience: Minimum 5-8 years of proven experience in content writing, copywriting, or editorial roles within reputed organizations, agencies, or digital platforms; experience creating long-format content and scripts for audio-visuals, social media articles, blogs, advertising, and marketing collaterals; strong academic background with proven excellence in written and verbal English communication.

rows.qualification: Minimum Bachelor's Degree in any stream with Advanced Diploma/Degree in Multimedia/Animation, Graphic Design, Visual Communication, Communication Design, or related disciplines from a recognised university.
rows.required_experience: Strategic understanding of brand design and creative direction; experience leading design projects or managing a creative team; strong portfolio highlighting versatility, conceptual thinking, and design leadership.

rows.qualification: Minimum Bachelor's Degree in any stream with Diploma/Degree in Film Production/Media Studies, Mass Communication/Visual Arts, or Animation from a recognised university.
rows.required_experience: Minimum 5-8 years of proven experience as a Video Editor in a professional setup, preferably in TV media, advertising, digital media, broadcasting, or a creative agency environment; experience working on social media videos, brand films, promotional videos, event coverage, interviews, documentaries, and corporate communications content.

rows.qualification: M.Phil in Clinical Psychology with a valid RCI License.
rows.experience: Required: Minimum 8 years of experience in a clinical or academic setting after Bachelor's in Psychology, including at least 2 years specifically as a Clinical Psychologist in a clinical setting. Desirable: 1 year of experience as a Clinical Psychologist in the Aviation Sector.

rows.qualification: M.Phil in Clinical Psychology with a valid RCI License.
rows.experience: Required: Minimum 5 years of experience in a clinical or academic setting after Bachelor's degree in Psychology. Desirable: 1 year of experience as a licensed Clinical Psychologist in a hospital/clinical setting.

content_sections.heading: Age Limit
content_sections.text: Age will be reckoned as on the cut-off/closing date, 06 August 2026, for all posts.

content_sections.heading: Charter of Duties
content_sections.text: Conduct legal research on issues relating to aviation laws, contracts, service matters, land acquisition, arbitration, constitutional and administrative law. Prepare Case Briefs, notes, and other documents pertaining to litigation of AAI. Liaise and coordinate AAI's litigation before various courts and tribunals. Pursue court cases and attend hearings before courts and tribunals on behalf of AAI. Draft, vet, and review legal documents including contracts, agreements, MoUs, affidavits, pleadings, written submissions, rejoinders, replies, notices, and correspondence; process profession fee bills of Lawyers. Maintain litigation and legal data on the AIMS (or other designated) Portal. Coordinate with departments, airports, and Corporate & regional offices for documents, reports, and records required for litigation. Assist in maintaining records of court orders, judgments, legal opinions, contracts, and arbitration awards. Perform other legal, research, or litigation duties as assigned by RED NR and GM (Law), CHQ. Draft, edit, and proofread communication materials including press releases, articles, reports, speeches, and digital content, ensuring accuracy, clarity, and consistency. Create visually appealing and professional graphics for invitations, backdrops, hoardings, social media content, brochures, and other promotional materials. Handle editing and production of multimedia content, transforming raw footage into engaging, polished video products. Coordinate with medical and HR teams for selection of ATCOs, ensuring quality and accuracy of verification methods. Plan and conduct periodic training on mental health promotion for ATCOs. Conduct Mental Status Examinations and interviews on referred or self-walk-in ATCOs. Administer, score, and interpret psychological tests for informed diagnosis. Support the medical team in evaluating fitness for safety-sensitive duties. Engage in psychoeducation and provide referrals for additional care when necessary. Visit outstation airports for mental health promotion lectures as required. Actively participate in the Peer Support Programme, maintaining confidentiality. Maintain quarterly databases of ATCO personality and cognitive profiles submitted by RHQ psychologists. Make presentations on enhancing ATCO mental wellbeing per DGCA guidelines. Coordinate with the Clinical Psychologist at CAP, CHQ for ATCO selection and verification. Plan and conduct periodic training on mental health promotion for ATCOs. Conduct Mental Status Examinations and interviews on referred or self-walk-in ATCOs. Administer psychological tests in consultation with the Clinical Psychologist at CAP, CHQ. Support the medical team in evaluating fitness for safety-sensitive duties. Provide counselling/psychotherapy for ATCOs and families, maintaining standardized records shared with CAP, CHQ. content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection for all posts will be based on academic qualifications, experience, document verification, and interview. Preliminary shortlisting will be based on documents uploaded with the online application. Documents supporting Qualifications, Experience, and Age must be uploaded with the application and produced in original at the time of Document Verification and interview. In case of false or insufficient information, candidature will be summarily rejected at any stage.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Interested and eligible candidates can apply online from 24 July 2026 (10:00 hrs) to 06 August 2026 (23:59 hrs) for the respective post(s). Candidates applying for more than one post must submit a separate application for each post. Ensure the email ID provided in the online application remains active, as call letters and further communication will be sent only by email. Mere submission of the application or meeting the eligibility criteria does not guarantee a call for interview/selection. For queries: Law Directorate - Helpline +91 9819703925; Corporate Communications - Helpline +91 9819703724; Clinical Psychologist - Helpline +91 9819703801.

faq.question: Q1. What is the total number of vacancies in AAI Consultant Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: A total of 10 vacancies have been announced across Law (05), Corporate Communications (03), and Clinical Psychology (02) directorates.

faq.question: Q2. Who is eligible to apply for Senior Consultant (Law) post?
faq.answer: Candidates with a professional degree in Law (3-year or 5-year integrated course) eligible for enrollment as an Advocate with the Bar Council of India, and 08–10 years of legal work experience.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification required for Consultant (Content Writer)?
faq.answer: Bachelor's degree in Mass Communication, Journalism, or English Literature, OR Bachelor's degree in any stream with a Master's Degree in Mass Communication/Journalism, with 5–8 years of content writing experience.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for Corporate Communications posts?
faq.answer: The upper age limit for all Corporate Communications posts (Content Writer, Graphic Designer, Video Editor) is 40 years as on 06 August 2026.

faq.question: Q5. How can I apply for AAI Consultant Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates must apply online through the official portal from 24 July 2026 (10:00 hrs) to 06 August 2026 (23:59 hrs).

faq.question: Q6. What is the remuneration for Senior Consultant (Law)?
faq.answer: Senior Consultant (Law) will receive ₹1,50,000 per month (all inclusive).

faq.question: Q7. What is the remuneration for Consultant (Clinical Psychologist)?
faq.answer: Consultant (Clinical Psychologist) will receive ₹1,20,000 per month (all inclusive).

faq.question: Q8. Can I apply for more than one post?
faq.answer: Yes, but candidates must submit a separate application for each post.

faq.question: Q9. What is the nature of engagement for these posts?
faq.answer: All posts are on a contractual basis – 1 year (Law & Corporate Communications, extendable) and 3 years (Clinical Psychologist).

faq.question: Q10. Where can I get more information about the recruitment?
faq.answer: Candidates can refer to the official notification on AAI's website or contact the helpline numbers provided for each directorate.
